observations: Two car headlights wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with multiple horizontal light bars.
The plastic lenses appear clear and undamaged in the photos.
The internal bulb sockets and wiring harnesses are not visible.
The items are resting on a cardboard surface in what appears to be a warehouse or garage setting.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping obscures the actual condition of the lenses and the presence of any dust or scratches.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The plastic lenses may have internal scratches or yellowing not visible through the film.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens surface without the plastic wrap.

risks.risk: The internal bulbs may be missing or burnt out.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.

risks.risk: The wiring harness may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the electrical connections.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the lens surface without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulbs and wiring.
Photo of the front of the headlights without the plastic wrap.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
